name: empty-state
purpose: Explains why a table, list, search, or page has nothing to show and offers the next step: a decorative icon or illustration, a title (a heading at a chosen level, or plain text inside tables and lists), a description, and up to two actions rendered as AbsoluteUI buttons or links. Three sizes; with live, a search that matches nothing is announced.
whenToUse: A table or list with no rows yet (first use) or no rows for the current filters.
A page or panel waiting for a selection, such as the detail pane of a master-detail layout.
whenNotToUse: Errors that need attention: use Alert or Inline Message.
Content that is still loading: use Skeleton or Spinner.
Short hints inside a form field: use help text.
responsive: Centered and fluid; text wraps at a readable measure and the actions wrap under each other on narrow containers.
rtl: Centered layout; the action order follows the writing direction.
theme: Component tokens empty-state-icon-color (color-text-muted) and empty-state-icon-size (icon-size-xl). Title uses color-text, the description color-text-muted; both are in the contrast gate. Actions are Buttons (primary and secondary).
security: Title and description are set as text; action hrefs are limited to http(s) and relative URLs; the illustration Node is inserted as given (the application owns it).
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

budgets.metric: EmptyState.create with an icon and two actions

performance.testedScale: One per table, list, or page.

limitations: The icon and illustration are decorative; put meaning in the title and description.
unsupported: Rich text (HTML) in the description: compose your own content Node next to it.
antiPatterns: Blaming the user ('You did not add anything'); say what is empty and what to do.
Showing an empty state while data is still loading.
